headline: Code Changes & Accelerated Review goes before Planning Commission Meeting on Thursday, October 8
blurb: The San Miguel County Planning Commission meets October 8 for a session that spans most of the day. The morning opens with a joint work session with the BOCC on an Affordable Housing Code Update — a signal that the county is still actively trying to write policy fast enough to keep pace with a housing situation that hasn't gotten easier.

meeting.title: Planning Commission Meeting
